description: This file defines a static helper class `CacheHelpers` that provides utility methods for generating cache keys and managing cache durations in a web project, specifically within the eShopOnWeb application's web extensions.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static class offering methods to generate cache keys for catalog items, brands, and types, as well as a default cache duration setting.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for catalog items based on pagination and optional filters such as brand and type IDs.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for brand listings.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for type listings.
